description: Department of Local Government - North Central Province - Declare K. W. M. S. B. Weerakoon as Chairman of Kahatagasdigiliya Pradeshiya Sabha in Anuradhapura District and K. A. S. R. S. K. K. Arachchi as Chairman of Horowpathana Pradeshiya Sabha
